title: IRDAI insurance sector KPIs

source.organization: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
source.title: IRDAI Annual Reports 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

methodology: Every figure is transcribed from an official IRDAI annual-report table or the report's Bird's Eye View. FY2019-20 comparatives come from IRDAI Annual Report 2020-21 because the scanned FY2019-20 report has no usable text layer. Penetration and density are Swiss Re figures reproduced by IRDAI and are labelled as such. Period labels follow IRDAI's own April-March fiscal-year convention, including tables that print calendar-style year headings.

metrics.name: Life insurers - new individual policies
metrics.definition: IRDAI 'Number of new policies issued' / 'New Individual Policies issued' for life insurers.

metrics.name: General, health and specialised insurers - policies issued
metrics.definition: IRDAI 'Number of new policies issued' / 'Policies Issued' for general, health and specialised insurers.

metrics.name: Life insurers - total premium
metrics.definition: Total premium underwritten by life insurers, including new and renewal business within India, as published by IRDAI.

metrics.name: Non-life insurers - premium
metrics.definition: IRDAI gross direct premium within and outside India for general, health and specialised insurers.

metrics.name: Non-life insurers - gross direct premium within India
metrics.definition: IRDAI gross direct premium within India for general, health and specialised insurers; distinct from the within-and-outside-India total.

source.title: Annual Reports 2020-21 to 2024-25, gross direct premium tables

metrics.name: Total insurance penetration
metrics.definition: Swiss Re penetration estimate for total insurance (life plus non-life), reproduced in IRDAI annual reports.

metrics.name: Life insurance penetration
metrics.definition: Swiss Re life-insurance penetration estimate reproduced in IRDAI annual reports, percent of GDP.

metrics.name: Non-life insurance penetration
metrics.definition: Swiss Re non-life penetration estimate reproduced in IRDAI annual reports, percent of GDP.

metrics.name: Total insurance density
metrics.definition: Swiss Re insurance-density estimate for total insurance, reproduced in IRDAI annual reports.

metrics.name: Life insurance density
metrics.definition: Swiss Re life-insurance density estimate reproduced in IRDAI annual reports, USD per capita.

metrics.name: Non-life insurance density
metrics.definition: Swiss Re non-life density estimate reproduced in IRDAI annual reports, USD per capita.

notes: Evidence: IRDAI Annual Report 2020-21 Table I.7 and premium/policy tables supply FY2019-20 comparatives: life penetration 2.82 percent, non-life 0.94 percent, total 3.76 percent; life density USD 58, non-life USD 19, total USD 78; life premium INR 572910.19 crore; life policies 288.47 lakh; non-life policies 2415.09 lakh; within-India non-life premium INR 188916.62 crore.
Evidence: IRDAI Annual Report 2021-22 Tables I.7-I.10 and I.18 supply FY2020-21 and FY2021-22 premiums, policies, penetration and density.

Evidence: IRDAI Annual Report 2023-24 Tables I.7-I.9 and I.12 supply FY2022-23 and FY2023-24 series; the FY2023-24 non-life within-India premium uses Table I.12 row 1 (289683.22) and within-and-outside total uses row 2 (293622.30).

Evidence: IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 Tables I.7-I.9 and I.12 supply FY2024-25 penetration 2.7 / 1.0 / 3.7 percent, density USD 72 / 25 / 97, life premium INR 885771.73 crore, non-life premiums INR 311666 crore (within and outside) and INR 307611 crore (within India), life policies 270.22 lakh and non-life policies 3913.53 lakh.

Period-label caveat: FY2023-24 and FY2024-25 penetration/density tables print India columns headed 2023 and 2024, but report notes and narrative sections assign those columns to April-March fiscal years.

Source discrepancy: the FY2024-25 report restates FY2023-24 non-life premiums slightly lower than the FY2023-24 report. This series keeps each figure from its first published annual report rather than blending restatements.
No FY2025-26 annual KPI value is shown: the IRDAI annual-reports listing had FY2024-25 as the latest published report when checked on 2026-11-26.
